+_URL = re.compile(r"(?:https?|ftp)://\S+")
+
+
+class _UrlSafeWrapper(textwrap.TextWrapper):
+    """TextWrapper that never splits a URL, even one longer than the width."""
+
+    def _split(self, text):
+        chunks, pos = [], 0
+        for m in _URL.finditer(text):
+            chunks += super()._split(text[pos : m.start()])
+            chunks.append(m.group())
+            pos = m.end()
+        return chunks + super()._split(text[pos:])
+
+    def _handle_long_word(self, reversed_chunks, cur_line, cur_len, width):
+        if _URL.fullmatch(reversed_chunks[-1]):
+            # Keep the URL whole: put it on its own line if the current one has text.
+            if not cur_line:
+                cur_line.append(reversed_chunks.pop())
+            return
+        super()._handle_long_word(reversed_chunks, cur_line, cur_len, width)
+
+
